name: dragonhide
lore_descriptor: scaled leather still warm from the kill
first_pickup_chronicle: Dragonhide. A sling stone hurled from a dragonhide pouch flies farther than a sling stone has any right to. Ask David. Ask the Mongols. Ask anyone who has actually killed a giant.
design_notes: Chain combat v2 tuning: damage_mult 1.55, weight_mult 0.85, no effective_against (T5 leather, no tag per doc). Endgame sling material.
